messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — Novus private deployment egress/fallback runbook needs owners. Found a gap in their air-gapped site: no NAT to internet for fallback model variants. Can owners please confirm next steps?
meera: Are we planning egress via a proxy in their DMZ or via a jumpbox? Proxy requires IP allowlist changes on their firewall.
devon: We recommended a jumpbox with outbound NAT. I can own the jumpbox infra but need neteng to approve 10.8.0.0/24 routing + firewall ports 443, 80. ping @neteng
neteng: @devon ok to route, but we need the AS path + a static route on their edge firewall. Also need the healthcheck endpoint (FQDN or IP) to add to the prober.
marta: For the airgap image push, we're blocked until the manifest is signed. Ops: @samir can you sign the container manifest? Last bundle had a checksum mismatch.
samir: On it — prepping signed bundle by EOD. Also: does Novus allow external KMS or do they require local HSM? That changes the secrets flow.
meera: Novus policy: local HSM only for key material. We'll need an HSM-onboarding ticket and a vault mount in their VPC. I'll open that ticket.
ops-bot: deploy-check: novus-bundle-2026-03-17 failed signature verification — see https://ci.internal/reds/4382 (log attached)
devon: quick example firewall snippet for their ops team (they'll adapt):
```
# allow outbound to Redwood model endpoints
ip route add 10.8.0.0/24 via 192.168.100.1
iptables -A OUTPUT -d 52.18.0.0/16 -p tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
```
neteng: Also note: fallback routing needs to reach model-variants.prod.redwood-inference.net via TLS SNI; confirm the customer's proxy trusts our CA. If they can't validate the cert, fallback won't work.
marta: Can someone confirm owners for runbook updates? Suggest: devon (jumpbox), meera (firewall/HSM ops), samir (manifest signing), neteng (routing). Reply with :thumbsup: to confirm.
alex: Agree on owners. I'll add entries to the rollout sheet and ping the Novus PM tomorrow. Action items/ETAs: devon create jumpbox terraform PR, meera open HSM ticket, samir produce signed bundle and upload, neteng document static route. Target: EOD tomorrow.
devon: PR WIP, will drop link when ready.
meera: HSM ticket created: #HN-492, assigned to security-oncall.
samir: Bundle signed and uploaded to s3://private-manifests/novus/2026-03-17/signed.tar.gz — checksum: sha256:3f8a... (DM me if you need access).
alex: Thanks — if anything blocks, flag it here and I'll escalate. I'll post a short summary in #customer-novus after the PM sync.
